💡 Vibe-Trading | Python
🎯 Primary Use Case: To provide a comprehensive and intelligent platform for individuals to engage in algorithmic trading, backtesting, and market analysis through a personal trading agent.
✨ Key Features: • Multi-agent trading system • AI-powered trading strategies • LLM integration for trading insights • Backtesting capabilities • FastAPI backend
📖 Summary: Vibe-Trading is a Python-based personal trading agent that empowers users with comprehensive trading capabilities. It leverages multi-agent systems, AI, and LLMs to facilitate algorithmic trading, backtesting, and market analysis through a FastAPI backend and React frontend.
